info.title: Event Management API
info.description: API documentation for Online Event Management System

401.description: Invalid email, password, or unverified account
Invalid email, password, or unverified account

get.description: Returns a paginated list of approved public events, filtered by status, type, category, organizer, or search term.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by one or more statuses (comma-separated)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in event titles or descriptions (case-insensitive)

get.description: Returns a limited list of upcoming events, sorted by nearest showtime date.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of upcoming events to return

get.description: Returns a single event with full details, including organizer info, showtimes, category, and meeting link.
Returns the number of seats available and the list of booked seats for a specific showtime.
Returns counts for total events, upcoming events, active users, and confirmed registrations.

showtimes.description: JSON string of showtimes. Example: '[{"date":"2025-08-20","time":"10:00","location":"New York","seats":100,"ticketPrice":50}]'

400.description: Validation error or invalid showtimes format

put.description: Update an existing event. Only the event organizer or admin can update. Offline events require location and seats in showtimes; online events require a meeting link.

type.description: If changed to online, meetingLink is required. If changed to offline, each showtime must include location and seats.

meetingLink.description: Required only if type is online

showtimes.description: JSON array of showtimes. For offline events: include date, time, ticketPrice, location, seats. For online events: include date, time, ticketPrice.

400.description: Invalid event ID or bad showtimes format

403.description: Not authorized to update this event
Not authorized to delete this event

get.description: Returns a list of registrations for a given event. Only accessible by the event organizer or admin.

post.description: Registers the authenticated user for an online event. Automatically generates one e-ticket with meeting link and sends it via email.

400.description: Event is not open for registration

post.summary: Register for an offline event showtime
post.description: Registers the authenticated user for a specific showtime of an offline event. Seats must be provided and will be validated against availability. Each booked seat generates a unique e-ticket.

parameters.name: showtimeId
parameters.description: Showtime ID of the offline event

400.description: Invalid seat selection or not enough seats available

get.description: Download the e-ticket as a PDF for the given ticket ID.

get.summary: Fetch booked seats for a specific event and showtime
Get all bookings for the logged-in user
get.description: Fetches all event registrations for the authenticated user, including event details, tickets, and the specific showtime booked.

500.description: Server error - Failed to fetch bookings
